caption:
Nobody tells you this. 🧠
You can ask a hospital about financial assistance before you put a bill on a card.
Many nonprofit hospitals are required to have a written plan.
Bills can also contain errors, so check yours.
Have you ever asked?

instagram.first_comment: Nobody tells you this. Follow @creditscoretruths for more.

card.headline: Before carding a medical bill, ask for assistance.
card.sub: Many nonprofit hospitals must have a plan.
